LogLevel.// System.Net.Http.HttpClient: Every /health and /up call pings Ollama and probes the vision model — two outbound HTTP requests, each of which AddHttpClient logs at Information as four lines (LogicalHandler + ClientHandler, start + end). An external monitor polling on a 60s interval therefore writes ~69k lines/day of pure noise, which rolled mcp's log retention down from the nominal 14 files to under 6 days and buried everything worth reading. The Embedder has carried this same suppression since it was written; the MCP never got it, which is the whole of the 270x log-volume gap between mcp and indexer.
